6. Slice into pinwheels and serve with Country Mustard Sauce and cocktail rye bread.

title: Swedish Rye Bread(Bread Machine Recipe)
description: A delicious swedish rye bread(bread machine recipe) recipe.
instructions:
1. Mix dry ingredients, except yeast and set aside.
2. Pour water and molasses into bread machine.
3. Add dry ingredients, yeast and butter.
4. Set machine for dough cycle. During the knead cycle, add any additional water or flour to bring dough to a soft (not gummy) consistency.
5. At end of dough cycle, turn onto floured surface. Let rest for 15 minutes.
6. Form into a round loaf.
7. Place onto a lightly greased baking sheet that has been sprinkled with corn meal.
8. Cover with a clean dish towel and let rise until doubled. Preheat oven to 375°.
9. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
10. Loaf should make a hollow sound when tapped on the bottom.
11. Cool for 15 minutes before slicing.
12. Serve buttered with paper-thin sliced ham for a special treat.

title: Polish Easter Cake
description: A delicious polish easter cake recipe.
instructions:
1. Scald milk.
2. Stir in sugar, salt and butter.
3. Cool to lukewarm.
4. Pour lukewarm water into a large bowl. Sprinkle yeast over top and stir until dissolved.
5. Add milk, eggs and flour. Beat vigorously for 5 minutes.
6. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 1/2 hours or until doubled.
7. Stir down batter.
8. Beat in almonds, raisins and lemon peel.
9. Pour batter into greased and floured Charlotte mold or deep cake pan.
10. Let rise for 1 hour. Bake at 350° for 50 minutes.
11. Let cool in pan for 20 minutes, then remove.

title: Clainy'S Frogmore Stew
description: A delicious clainy's frogmore stew recipe.
instructions:
1. Fill large Dutch oven halfway with water; add 1/4 cup Old Bay seasoning.
2. Bring to a boil; add potatoes and bring to a second boil.
3. Add sausage and corn and bring to boil.
4. Cook 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
5. Add shrimp, pepper and juice and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until shrimp turns pink.
6. Remove with slotted spoon onto a serving platter.
7. Serve immediately with cocktail sauce.

title: Microwave Chex Party Mix
description: A quick and easy savory snack mix, perfect for parties or anytime munching. This recipe features cereals, nuts, and pretzels coated in a buttery, seasoned sauce and baked until crispy.
instructions: 1. Melt butter on High for 30 seconds. Add salt and Worcestershire sauce; mix well. Pour cereals, nuts and pretzels in a large plastic bag. Pour butter mixture over cereal; shake to coat. Pour into a large bowl and microwave on High for 3 minutes, stirring every minute. Spread on paper towels to cool.

title: Mushroom Sauce(Served On Christmas Eve Over Varenyky-Pyrohy)
description: A rich and savory mushroom sauce traditionally served over varenyky (Ukrainian dumplings). This dish brings earthy flavors to your holiday table, especially on Christmas Eve.
instructions:
1. Rinse dried mushrooms and soak about 5 to 10 minutes in enough water to cover.
2. Chop mushrooms and put in 1 quart saucepan.
3. Add cold water to cover, about 2 to 3 inches from the top of the mushrooms.
4. Cover; bring to a boil, reduce heat to simmer and add fresh chopped mushrooms.
5. Cook about 1 hour until soft.

title: Quick Hearty Nacho Dip
description: This quick and hearty nacho dip combines seasoned ground beef, beans, and picante sauce, topped with melted Cheddar cheese. It's a perfect appetizer for gatherings, served hot with tortilla chips.
instructions:
1. Cook first 3 ingredients in large skillet until meat is brown; drain.
2. Add beans, picante sauce and taco seasoning mix. Stir well.
3. Cook over medium heat until blended.
4. Spoon into 12 x 8 x 2 dish.
5. Sprinkle with cheese.
6. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes until cheese melts.
7. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Ugly Shonton Meat Balls
description: Despite their name, these meat balls are delicious! Made with ground chuck and simmered in a creamy mushroom and wine sauce, they are a comforting meal option.
ingredients: 1 (10-ounce) can of cream of mushroom soup
instructions:
1. Mix first 7 ingredients well and form into balls.
2. Brown gently, add wine.
3. Simmer until wine is evaporated.
4. Add soup mixed with milk.
5. Simmer until sauce is down to about half.

title: Dorothy'S Old Fashioned Saltwater Dills
description: A classic recipe for old-fashioned saltwater dill pickles. Cucumbers are brined with garlic, dill, and optional hot peppers for a crisp and tangy treat.
instructions:
1. Combine the cider vinegar, salt and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
2. Pack the sterilized wide-mouth jars with cucumbers, a piece of fresh garlic, hot pepper (if using), a fresh grape leaf and fresh dill.
3. Pour the boiling brine over the cucumbers, leaving a little headspace. Seal the jars tightly.
4. Store in a cool, dark place for about 30 days. Refrigerate after opening.

title: Herbed Mushroom Salad
description: A refreshing and savory mushroom salad marinated in a blend of herbs, lemon, and Worcestershire sauce. Serve over a bed of shredded lettuce for a light appetizer or side dish.
instructions:
1. Place mushrooms in small bowl.
2. Combine all ingredients except shredded lettuce and pour over mushrooms.
3. Marinate a few hours or overnight.
4. Arrange shredded lettuce in salad bowls; top with mushrooms.

title: Quickie Meat And Cheese Dip
description: An incredibly simple and fast cheese and chili dip, perfect for a quick snack. Just microwave Velveeta cheese and chili, then serve with chips.
ingredients: 2 cups of canned chili without beans
instructions: 1. "Nuke" in microwave and eat with chips.

title: Fasta Pasta - 10 Minute Pasta Sauce
description: A quick and vibrant pasta sauce featuring fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, and a hint of red wine. This sauce comes together in just 10 minutes, perfect for a fast meal.
instructions:
1. In a heavy skillet, add oil, fresh tomatoes and 1/4 of wine. Saute until the tomatoes cook down until soft and tender.
2. Add garlic, onion, basil and can of cooked tomatoes and rest of wine. Cook on high for 2 minutes, then cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Pour over your choice of pasta and add Parmesan cheese.

title: Party Cucumber Sandwiches
description: Elegant and easy party cucumber sandwiches, perfect for appetizers or tea time. Cream cheese and mayonnaise are flavored with Italian dressing mix and spread on rye bread, topped with fresh cucumber slices.
instructions:
1. Mix first 3 ingredients and spread on bread.
2. Cut in small squares and top with cucumber slices.

title: *Low-Cholesterol Pound Cake*
description: A moist and tender low-cholesterol pound cake, perfect for dessert or a snack. This recipe uses margarine and egg substitutes to create a lighter version of a classic.
instructions:
1. Cream the margarine, shortening and sugar in mixer bowl until light and fluffy.
2. Add egg white; beat well.
3. Add egg substitute; beat well.
4. Add flour alternately with milk, beating well after each addition.
5. Add flavorings.
6. Pour into greased and floured tube pan.
7. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Potato Pancake
description: A simple yet satisfying potato pancake, crispy on the outside and tender within. Potatoes are pan-fried until golden, seasoned with salt and pepper.
instructions:
1. Put 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet.
2. Set over medium heat until butter melts.
3. Put potatoes in the skillet.
4. Press them down into an even compact layer. Cook, covered, for 5 minutes.
5. Uncover, turn heat to low and cook for 15 minutes more.
6. Slide the pancake onto a plate.
7. Put 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter into the skillet.
8. When the butter melts, put the pancake back into the skillet with the browned side up.
9. Press down to compact the potatoes and cook, uncovered, for 15 minutes more. Cut into 4 wedges and serve warm.

title: Hamburger Barbecue(Sloppy Joes)
description: Classic Hamburger Barbecue, often known as Sloppy Joes, featuring seasoned ground beef simmered in a tangy tomato-based sauce. Perfect served on buns for a family-friendly meal.
instructions:
1. Melt margarine in large skillet.
2. Brown hamburger meat.
3. Mix onions, green pepper and celery.
4. Cook over low heat 5 minutes. Blend in tomato sauce, chili sauce, Worcestershire, pepper, salt, sugar and vinegar.
5. Simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring often. Serve on hamburger buns.

title: Heavenly Ham Salad
description: A refreshing ham salad featuring shell macaroni, crisp vegetables, and a creamy yogurt-based dressing. This dish is perfect for picnics or a light lunch.
instructions:
1. Prepare and cook macaroni; set aside.
2. Drain.
3. Combine macaroni, ham, celery, radishes and cucumber.
4. Blend together mayonnaise, yogurt, mustard and garlic salt.
5. Toss dressing with salad mixture.
6. Serve immediately or cover and chill.
7. Refrigerate leftovers.
8. Serves 6 to 8.

title: English Pasty
description: A hearty English Pasty, filled with layers of diced potatoes, minced onion, and tender pork loin, all encased in a savory pie crust. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions:
1. Place bottom crust in 8-inch pie pan.
2. Spread diced potatoes evenly over bottom crust.
3. Sprinkle minced onion over potatoes. Spread pieces of pork evenly on top of potatoes and onion.
4. Season to taste.
5. Cover with vented top pie crust and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Breakfast Blintz Souffle
description: A sweet and comforting breakfast blintz souffle featuring frozen cheese blintzes baked in a rich custard. This dish is perfect for a special breakfast or brunch.
instructions:
1. Melt butter in a 13 x 9-inch pan.
2. Put frozen blintzes in dish and coat well with butter.
3. Mix remaining ingredients with electric mixer and pour over blintzes.
4. Be sure to cover all. Bake 50 minutes at 350°.
5. Serve with applesauce, sour cream or jam.

title: American Pierogi Casserole
description: An 'Americanized' take on pierogi in casserole form, featuring layers of noodles, mashed potato and onion filling, and American cheese. It's a comforting and hearty dish suitable for families.
instructions:
1. Sauté the onion in the butter until soft.
2. Combine the onion with the boiled, drained potatoes and mash until smooth.
3. Butter a large casserole dish and layer half of the cooked noodles in the bottom.
4. Spread the mashed potato mixture over the noodles and top with half of the cheese slices.
5. Add the remaining noodles and top with the rest of the cheese.
6. Dot with butter, cover and bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted.

title: Pan Pierogi(This Is A Lazy Way To Make Pierogi!)
description: This is a 'lazy' way to enjoy the flavors of pierogi without all the traditional effort, using lasagna noodles filled with a creamy potato and Velveeta cheese mash. Pan-fried onions complete this comforting dish.
instructions:
1. Boil potatoes in salted water; mash with butter, milk and Velveeta cheese.
2. (This can be done the night before.) Cook lasagna noodles.
3. While noodles are cooking, fry onions in butter. Set aside.
4. Butter a large casserole dish (9 x 13-inch).
5. Layer four noodles on bottom of pan and spread half of the potato mixture on them.
6. Top with 4 more noodles.
7. Put half the onions on top of noodles and spread the rest of the potato mixture.
8. Place the last 4 noodles on top and cover with onions.
9. Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.
10. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving.

title: Polish Beet Soup
description: A classic Polish beet soup, rich in flavor with tender spareribs, bay leaf, and a delightful tang from vinegar. This vibrant red soup is a hearty and traditional dish.
instructions:
1. Drain the beet juice into a glass; stir in 2 tablespoons of the vinegar and 1 teaspoon of the salt.
2. Cut the beets into thin strips and toss with the remaining 3 tablespoons vinegar and 1 teaspoon salt. Set aside to marinate.
3. Simmer the spareribs with the onion and bay leaf in enough water to cover for about 1 hour, until tender.
4. Add the prepared beets and beet juice and heat through without letting the soup boil hard.
5. Serve with sour cream.

title: Stella Adamek'S Rye Bread
description: Homemade rye bread combining different flours for a rich texture. It involves proofing, kneading, and baking, perfect for a hearty sandwich or alongside a warm meal.
instructions:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl.
2. Combine the next 3 ingredients in a cup and add to the dry ingredients.
3. Work in the white flour, adding it gradually until the dough comes together.
4. Place on a floured board and knead for 8 to 10 minutes.
5. Place in a greased container and let rise until doubled.
6. Punch down the dough, shape it into 2 loaves and place in greased loaf pans.
7. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 45 minutes.
8. Bake at 375°F for 35–40 minutes, until the loaves sound hollow when tapped. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Trish'S Polska Kielbasa Soup
description: A comforting Polish kielbasa soup, enriched with chicken broth and hearty vegetables like carrots, cabbage, and broccoli. Quick to thicken with instant mashed potatoes for a satisfying meal.
instructions:
1. Combine chicken broth, water, Polska kielbasa and carrots. Simmer for one hour, then add cabbage and broccoli.
2. Simmer until tender, then add instant potatoes to desired thickness.
3. Pepper to taste.
4. Knorr all-purpose seasoning to taste.

title: Stuffed Hot Peppers(Canning Recipe)
description: A canning recipe for stuffed hot peppers filled with sauerkraut and garlic, preserved in a vinegar brine. Ideal for a spicy and tangy condiment to enjoy year-round.
instructions:
1. Core peppers (don't break), wearing rubber gloves.
2. Wash and boil 2 minutes.
3. Cool in ice water.
4. Stuff with sauerkraut.
5. Pack in sterilized jars.
6. Add garlic and alum.
7. Cover with solution of water, vinegar and salt.
8. Boil in hot bath for 3 to 5 minutes. Seal.

title: San Jose Quiche
description: A savory San Jose Quiche featuring ground beef, onions, garlic, and green peppers, seasoned with Mexican spices. Layered with tortillas and cheese, this is a hearty and flavorful main dish.
instructions:
1. Brown beef; add chopped onions, garlic and green pepper.
2. Cook 5 minutes.
3. Stir in salsa, oregano, cumin, chili powder and salt. Grease casserole dish and put a layer of tortilla chips in dish. Top with meat mixture.
4. Spread on chile Ortegas, and top with cheese.
5. Beat eggs with milk and 1/2 teaspoon salt.
6. Pour over top.
7. Bake at 375° for 25 to 30 minutes or until set.
8. Garnish with olives.

title: Fried Fish Batter
description: A simple and quick batter for perfectly fried fish fillets. Using pancake mix, it creates a crispy coating in just minutes.
instructions:
1. Whisk the egg, the 1 cup pancake mix and the water until smooth, with the consistency of thick cream.
2. Dust the fish fillets with the remaining pancake mix.
3. Dip the fillets in the batter.
4. Fry in hot oil for 4–6 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.

title: Russian Cole Slaw
description: A refreshing Russian-style coleslaw with finely chopped cabbage and green onions, lightly sweetened with sugar and tangy vinegar. A simple side dish that complements any meal.
instructions:
1. Finely shred the cabbage and chop the green onions and celery.
2. Sprinkle the vegetables with the sugar and salt and rub lightly with your hands until they begin to soften.
3. Whisk the salad oil with the vinegar and mustard; pour over the salad and toss well.
4. Let stand for 15–20 minutes before serving.

title: Campfire Goulash
description: A hearty campfire goulash featuring sweet sausage, onions, potatoes, and tomatoes. This one-pot meal is perfect for outdoor cooking or a comforting weeknight dinner, simmering to rich perfection.
instructions:
1. In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, saute sausage until lightly browned on both sides.
2. Add onion and saute until transparent. Add potatoes and sauce mix. Gradually stir in water.
3. Bring to a boil and cover. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring often.
4. Add tomatoes and green pepper. Mix well.
5. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes longer.
6. Yields 6 servings.

title: Stew Beef Casserole
description: A simple and comforting stew beef casserole, slow-baked with a blend of savory soups and sauces. This easy-to-prepare dish yields tender beef and a rich flavor, perfect for a cozy dinner.
ingredients: 1 (10-ounce) can of cream of mushroom soup
instructions:
1. Mix well together the soup, A.1. sauce and Worcestershire sauce.
2. Add to stew beef which has been salted and peppered to taste.
3. Put in casserole dish.
4. Bake, covered, for 3 hours at 300°.
5. Serve over rice.

title: Challah
description: A traditional Challaha, a rich and slightly sweet bread, characterized by its beautiful braided shape. Made with yeast, eggs, and honey, it's perfect for holidays or a special breakfast.
instructions:
1. Dissolve the yeast in the warm water with 2 tablespoons sugar.
2. Cover and let stand in a warm place.
3. Place the butter in a mixing bowl with the salt and boiling water.
4. When melted, add the oil, remaining sugar and honey.
5. Add the 6 eggs, one at a time, mixing at low speed.
6. Add the yeast mixture and mix in 4 cups of the flour.
7. Add the remaining flour and knead for 10 minutes on a table dusted with flour.
8. Put the dough in a buttered bowl and turn it once, butter side up.
9. Cover and let rise for 1 hour, until doubled.
10. Punch down the dough and let it rise again for 1 hour, until doubled.
11. Shape the dough into a braid (or two smaller braids) and place on a greased baking sheet.
12. Cover and let rise for 30–45 minutes, until puffed.
13. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 350°F for 35–40 minutes, until golden and hollow-sounding. Cool on a wire rack.

title: Swiss Potato Pancakes
description: Crispy Swiss potato pancakes, enhanced with Swiss cheese and a hint of onions. Pan-fried until golden, these savory pancakes are perfect as a side dish or light meal.
instructions:
1. Grate the potatoes and Swiss cheese on the coarse side of a grater. Finely chop the onion and red pepper.
2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt and pepper. Add the softened cream cheese and margarine and rub with a fork until crumbly.
3. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with a little water. Combine the dry mixture with the eggs, then add the vegetables and grated cheese; mix thoroughly.
4. Divide the mixture into equal portions and shape into small patties.
5. Fry in a mixture of vegetable oil and margarine over medium heat until golden brown on both sides.

title: Crock-Pot Kielbasa
description: Slow-cooked kielbasa simmered in a tangy-sweet sauce of ketchup, mustard, vinegar, and brown sugar. Perfect for a cozy meal, as an appetizer, or in a bun.
instructions:
1. Boil kielbasa in beer for 10 minutes.
2. Combine ketchup, mustard, vinegar and sugar in crock-pot.
3. Cut kielbasa in small bite size pieces and place in crock-pot.
4. Cook on high for 2 to 3 hours or low for 3 to 5 hours.
5. Enjoy.
